basic_info.description: Discover this stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo on the coveted north slope of sunny Potrero Hill. This bright and airy home boasts an open floor plan with partial Downtown and Bay Bridge views from the living room, dining area, kitchen, and private balcony. The spacious primary suite features two closets and an en-suite bath, while the generously sized second bedroom offers ample storage and an adjacent full bathroom. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, one-car secured garage parking, and a private storage room.  Located in the highly desirable Victoria Mews, residents enjoy resort-style amenities, including a pool, spa, sauna, gym, tennis courts, clubroom, and beautifully landscaped gardens with tranquil streams. Just moments from neighborhood favorites like Whole Foods, local restaurants, and shops, plus easy access to 101, 280, and Caltrain, this home blends urban convenience with serene living.
